description: Load the find_references picture picked for a planned illustration (or the user's own picture as data_url); the reply shows it. Not in the design.

candidate.description: The candidate id you picked from find_references for this illustration.

data_url.description: Instead of candidate: a picture the user supplied, as a PNG, JPEG or WebP data URL.

illustration.description: The planned illustration, by its name in plan_illustrations.

name.description: What the picture shows, e.g. "warehouse with an open loading bay".
